visibleTestCases.title: Two-Stage Pipeline Computation
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin {ok, W1, W2} = linked_pipeline:start_linked_pipeline(), {ok, Res} = linked_pipeline:compute(W1, 3), {Res, is_process_alive(W1), is_process_alive(W2)} end
visibleTestCases.explanation: 3 doubled to 6 by Stage 1, squared to 36 by Stage 2. Both processes alive.

visibleTestCases.title: Normal Exit Leaves Linked Peer Alive
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin {ok, W1, W2} = linked_pipeline:start_linked_pipeline(), ok = linked_pipeline:stop_stage1_normal(W1), timer:sleep(40), {is_process_alive(W1), is_process_alive(W2)} end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Stage 1 exited with normal; Stage 2 ignored normal signal and remained alive.

visibleTestCases.title: Abnormal Crash Propagates Across Link
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin {ok, W1, W2} = linked_pipeline:start_linked_pipeline(), ok = linked_pipeline:crash_stage1(W1, fatal_crash), timer:sleep(40), {is_process_alive(W1), is_process_alive(W2)} end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Abnormal crash in Stage 1 propagated across link, terminating Stage 2.
